provenance.source_document: SRMIST B.Tech Regulation 2021 Curriculum & Syllabus - 21MAB204T Probability and Queueing Theory
provenance.notes: Authoritative 5-unit syllabus covering random variables, two-dimensional random variables, random processes, and single/multi-server queueing models.
